content: उपदृश् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To see, behold, look at, perceive. --{%<ab>pass.</ab>%} .²1 To be or become visible. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to see, show or exhibit. .²2 To place before, show up, communicate, make (one) acquainted (with); राज्ञः पुरो मामुपदर्श्य <ls>H. 3</ls>; नयविद्भिर्नवे राज्ञि सदसच्चोपदर्शितम् <ls>R. 4. 10</ls>. .²3 To present a false appearance, deceive a person by a false appearance, illude. .²4 To explain, illustrate; चतुष्पाद्व्यवहारोऽयं विवादेषूपदर्शितः <ls>Y. 2. 8</ls>.
उपदृश् {%a.%} Seeing, witnessing (as the sun and moon). {%f.%} Aspect, view (<ab>Ved.</ab>).
